GameState

class GameState(player_id=0, player_name='', professional_id=0, session_id=0, phase=1, level=1, level_time=120, hud=True, sound=True, feet_marker=False, feet_click=False, lane=1, menu='Inicial', time_past=0.0, delta_time=0.016666666666666666, targets_spawn_time=8, targets_move_speed=1, level_stats=<factory>, session_stats=<factory>)[source]

Bases: object

Mutable state of a match.

Attributes:
player_idint

Who plays (command line argument). Defaults to 0.

player_namestr

First name of the player, shown under the trophy on the feedback screen. Defaults to “”.

professional_idint

Who supervises (command line argument). Defaults to 0.

session_idint

Open session (0 while none was created). Defaults to 0.

phaseint

Phase in progress. Defaults to 1.

levelint

Level in progress. Defaults to 1.

level_timeint

Level duration (s). Defaults to 120.

hudbool

Interface option (can be toggled during the game). Defaults to True.

soundbool

Interface option (can be toggled during the game). Defaults to True.

feet_markerbool

Draws the dot at the real feet position during the game. Defaults to False.

feet_clickbool

The feet select the menu buttons (the dot always appears in the menus). Defaults to False.

laneint

Current lane of the player (0, 1, 2; -1 outside the area). Defaults to 1.

menustr

Menu screen to show: “Inicial”, “Pause”, “Feedback_1..3”. Defaults to “Inicial”.

time_pastfloat

Game time (ms) of the level in progress. Defaults to 0.0.

delta_timefloat

Real time (s) since the previous frame, already capped. Defaults to 1/60.

targets_spawn_timefloat

Interval (s) between objects in the current level. Defaults to 8.

targets_move_speedint

Speed of the objects in the current level. Defaults to 1.

level_statsLevelStats

Counters of the level in progress.

session_statsSessionStats

Totals of the session.

Methods

from_settings

Create the initial state from the effective configuration.
classmethod from_settings(settings, player_id, professional_id)[source]

Create the initial state from the effective configuration.

Parameters:
settingsdict

Dictionary from PlayerKarteaConfigService.build_game_settings.

player_idint

Who plays.

professional_idint

Who supervises.

Returns:
GameState

State with phase, level, level time and interface options from settings; feet_marker/feet_click default to False when missing.

Examples

>>> settings = {
...     "phase_id": "2", "level_id": 3, "level_time": 60,
...     "hud": 1, "sound": 0,
... }
>>> state = GameState.from_settings(settings, 1, 2)
>>> state.phase, state.level, state.sound, state.feet_click
(2, 3, False, False)
